details.description:
From Richard Hellmann’s Deli in New York to tables all around the world, Hellmann’s has truly become the World’s No. 1 Mayonnaise Brand. With a rich, creamy texture and an unmistakable taste, it’s no wonder Hellmann’s is winning hearts across the globe. Delicious, smooth and 100% vegetarian, Hellmann’s Real Mayonnaise pairs well with sandwiches, burgers and almost everything else, so that you can truly bring out the best in your food. Spread it across a slice of toast, or dollop it onto your burger and relish its wonderful, wholesome flavour.
Hellmann’s Real mayonnaise is crafted with quality ingredients, which are an excellent source of good fats such as Poly Unsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFA)/ Omega 6 are virtually trans-fat-free and are fortified with essential vitamins A & D. So, you can enjoy all of the deliciousness without any of the guilt. Our perfectly balanced mayonnaise elevates every dish – whether it’s a hearty burger or crunchy French fries.
Simply grab a bottle and add a creamy dollop of Hellmann’s Real mayonnaise in your pasta, bakes and more. You know you can always rely on Hellmann’s mayonnaise to make a good meal, great. #Source Euromonitor International Limited. Packaged Foods 2020 edition, retail value sales, umbrella brand name classification (includes all Hellmann's and Best Foods brand sales) 2020 data. This is only a brand name/trademark and does not represent its true nature.
details.ingredients: Water, Sugar, Thickeners-E 1442, E 1450, Natural Vinegar, Iodised Salt, Spices & Condiments, Lemon Juice Concentrate, Preservative-E 202, Nature Identical & Natural Flavouring Substances, Sequestrant-E 385. May contain traces of Soya.
details.usageInstructions: After opening, keep refrigerated and use within six months or use by date whichever is earlier.

details.description:
Experience the ultimate burst of cheese flavour with Hellmann's Cheezy Jalapeño mayo. Imagine the creamy deliciousness of cheese and the spicy kick of jalapeño infused in a rich mayo, providing the perfect creamy center to your grilled cheese sandwich. This savoury sensation leaves you feeling satisfied and craving more. Hellmann's Mayonnaise is globally loved for its distinctive taste and creamy texture. Crafted with vegetarian ingredients, it adds a deliciously smooth flavour to a variety of dishes, from sandwiches and burgers to wraps and fries.
Hellmann's Mayonnaise is globally recognised for its rich, creamy texture and distinctive taste. Made with simple, vegetarian ingredients, it's the perfect addition to a variety of dishes, from sandwiches to burgers, enhancing their flavour with its smooth, delicious taste.
Our mayonnaise is crafted with quality ingredients, making it an excellent source of good fats, such as Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids and Omega 6. Virtually trans-fat-free and fortified with essential vitamins A & D, you can enjoy its creamy goodness without guilt.
Hellmann's perfectly balanced veg mayonnaise is a game-changer, elevating every dish it graces. From hearty burgers to crunchy French fries, sandwiches, wraps, and even pasta and bakes, a dollop of our creamy mayo enhances the flavour, making every meal more enjoyable.
According to Euromonitor International Limited, Hellmann's and Best Foods brand sales were the top-selling brands in retail value sales for 2024, making Hellmann's the World's best mayonnaise brand. So, why wait? Grab a bottle of Hellmann's Cheezy Jalapeño mayo today and experience the rich, creamy taste that has won hearts worldwide.
details.ingredients: Water, Refined Soybean Oil (Fortified With Vitamin A & D), Cheese Seasoning (8%) (Maltodextrin, Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion, Garlic), Cheese Powder (1%), Sugar, Whey Powder, Dextrose, High Fat Dairy Whitener, Natural And Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Cream Analogue, Corn Starch, Flavour Enhancer (627, 631), Anticaking Agent (551)), Thickeners (1442, 1450, 412), Sugar, Diced Jalapeno (3%), Natural Vinegar, Lodised Salt, Acidity Regulator (330), Natural And Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Preservative (202), Sequestrant (385).
